title: KNUST boosts petroleum engineering output with largest MSc cohort
desc: The Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi (KNUST) has produced its largest cohort of petroleum engineering master’s graduates, with 25 students completing the programme as demand grows for specialised skills in the energy sector. The graduating class represents a 100% increase from the inaugural cohort of 12 students last year, while the programme recorded a 90% completion rate, with most students finishing within the expected period. The expansion reflects rising enrolment in petroleum and energy-related studies, as universities respond to industry demand for technically trained professionals.
